title: ranunculus ophiocladus
intro: Ranunculus ophiocladus, commonly known as Crow Buttercup, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, pain, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus ophiocladus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
